affinityRetryPatch.scope: Experimental startup-only retry of sched_setaffinity EINVAL, up to 20 attempts 10ms apart; not shipped in APK.

method.tool: Prism llama-bench, CPU only, shell UID 2000
method.warmup: Default llama-bench warmup retained: full prompt or one generated token.
method.cooldown: Before each case: CPU7 scaling cap >=98% nominal; hottest compute zone <=47 C (first cases <=44 C).
method.cache: Kernel file cache was neither dropped nor locked. read_bytes and faults quantify differing residency.
method.sampling: Procfs snapshots every approximately 10 s; thermal state immediately before and after.
method.affinity: strict=1 pins individual threads; strict=0 gives each thread the common selected CPU mask.
method.screen: Awake during benchmarks; original stay_on_while_plugged_in restored after each run.
method.charging: Phone remained connected to power; active cooling not used.
method.userIdle: Runs from internal-base-t4-relaxed-tg64 onward followed the user confirmation to leave the phone idle.
method.app: PI DECK native model server stopped; installed release APK/runtime unchanged.
limits: Synthetic short-context runs, not application TTFT or answer quality.
Each row is one timed sample, unless samples_ts explicitly contains more.
Cooling threshold does not equalize stored device heat; all long cases throttled.
No isolated speedup can be derived from cases with different cache pressure.
PR249 binary retains baseline build string; artifact SHA identifies the patch.

prefillEnvironment.action: KEYCODE_HOME before first prefill-only run; PI DECK UI was foreground and had observable CPU activity while its model server was stopped.

strict.observation: Over 90% of sampled user-space instructions resolve to barrier/relax code after accounting for inlining; failed pinned worker mostly shares CPU7 with main thread.

relaxedRepeat.observation: Despite shared mask 3-7 on all five threads, two workers exclusively shared CPU7 during the sampled window; most samples are in barriers.

repinned.observation: Same process after successful taskset of one worker per fast core; each worker sampled on its assigned CPU.

profileMethod.limits: Sampled user-space CPU time in short windows, not whole-run wall time. Profiled runs include profiler overhead.

noMmapRejection: Manually stopped after about 3 GiB of process swap and memory PSI full avg10 >13%; no completed throughput sample.
